blocks.html: The data to manage a price list's prices.

types.name: data
types.description: The data to manage the prices of a price list.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the price list.

children.name: currency_code
children.description: The currency code for the price. It's normalized to lowercase when stored. For example, `EUR` is stored as `eur`.

children.name: variant_id
children.description: The ID of the variant that this price applies to.

children.name: max_quantity
children.description: The maximum quantity of the variant allowed in the cart for this price to be applied.

children.name: min_quantity
children.description: The minimum quantity of the variant required in the cart for this price to be applied.

children.name: rules
children.description: Additional rules for the price list.

children.name: variant_id
children.description: The ID of the product variant that this price belongs to.

children.description: The currency code of the price. It's normalized to lowercase when stored. For example, `EUR` is stored as `eur`.

children.name: max_quantity
children.description: The maximum quantity of the variant allowed in the cart for this price to be applied.

children.name: min_quantity
children.description: The minimum quantity of the variant required in the cart for this price to be applied.

children.name: delete
children.description: The IDs of prices to delete.
